itthibhāva.p: [Itthī+bhāva] (pu) CL=8 (A) as to be a woman, The concept of being a woman, the concept of being a woman that is the nature (appearance), Itthibhāvarupa, female gene appearance,  itthatta-(A)-see. (a) as a woman, female life (or) woman life, five aggregates embodying a being (female/woman). (A) Itthatta-(A)- see.
a: ဣတ္ထိဘာဝ(ပု)

(က)မိန်းမ၏အဖြစ်၊ မိန်းမ ဖြစ်ကြောင်း-မိန်းမဟု သိသောစိတ်, မိန်းမဟူသော နာမည်တို့၏ ဖြစ်ကြောင်း-သဘောတရား-ရုပ်တရား၊ ဣတ္ထိဘာဝရုပ်၊ အမမျိုးစေ့ရုပ်။ ဣတ္ထတ္တ-(က)-ကြည့်။(ခ)မိန်းမ၏အဖြစ်၊ မိန်းမဘဝ၊ မိန်းမ၏ခန္ဓာငါးပါး။(က)ဣတ္ထတ္တ-(က)-ကြည့်။

Vin I 191, 19 (yānena yāyanti itthīyuttena purisantarena purisayuttena pi ~ena; Sp 1085, 23 : ~enā ti itthīsārathinā); — °’- indriya , n. , the feminine faculty or principle of femininity ; S V 204, 14 (~aṃ purisindriyaṃ jīvitindriyaṃ); A IV 57, 5 (itthi … ajjhattaṃ ~aṃ manasikaroti); Dhs 633 (yaṃ itthiyā itthiliṅgaṃ itthinimittaṃ itthikuttaṃ itthākappo itthattaṃ itthibhāvo idaṃ taṃ rūpaṃ ~aṃ) ≠ Vibh 122, 24 ; Yam II 62, 3 ; Peṭ 162, 4 ; Vism 491, 7 ; As 321, 24 (itthibhāvasaṅkhāte ~e sati itthiliṅgādīni honti); — °- kutta , n. , female contriving, feminine wiles; a woman’s ways ; A IV 57, 6 (Mp IV 32, 19 : ~an ti itthikiriyaṃ); Dhs 633 ≠ Vibh 122, 23 ; Ja I 296, 21 (~aṃ itthilīḷaṃ dassetvā); II 329, 26 (~ena palobhetvā); — °- ghaṭā , f. , a crowd of women ; Ja IV 316, 22 (~āya, Be, Ce, Se so; Ee wr iṭṭhi-); — °- ghātaka , m. , a killer of women ; Ja V 398, 8´ ; — °(i)- tta , n., abstr. , 1. the state of being a woman; femaleness ; Dhs 633 (yaṃ itthiyā … itthākappo ~aṃ itthibhāvo, Se so; Be, Ce, Ee itthattaṃ) ≠ Vibh 122, 24 ( Ee, Se so; Be, Ce itthattaṃ); Sv 706, 15 foll. (~aṃ nāma alaṃ, na hi ~e ṭhatvā cakkavattisiriṃ … adhigantuṃ sakkā ti, Be, Se so; Ee itthattaṃ nāma, alaṃ itthattena, na hi itthatte …; Ce ittatthaṃ nāma … ittatthena … ittatthe); — 2. the being in the feminine gender ; Sadd 770, 21 ; — see also itthatta 2 ; — °- dhutta , m. , a womaniser ; A IV 283, 14 ; Sn 106 (~o surādhutto akkhadhutto); Ja IV 248, 22 ; — °- nimitta , n. , a female characteristic, esp. the female sexual organ; a feminine attribute ; Dhs 633 ≠ Vibh 122, 23 ; Sp 257, 17 ; — °- paṇḍakā , f. , an asexual female (without pudenda) ;? ( n. ) ( i ) femininity; feminine characteristics; the female sexual characteristic(s) ; Vin III 35, 12 (aññatarassa bhikkhuno ~aṃ pātubhūtaṃ hoti); D III 88, 24 (itthiyā ca ~aṃ pāturahosi); Dhs 633 ≠ Vibh 122, 23 ; Mil 267, 13 (dissati purisassa ~aṃ pātubhūtam); Bv-a 91, 28 (~e ṭhitassa manussajātikassa pi patthanā na samijjhati); — ( ii ) ( gr.t.t. ) the feminine gender ; Ja IV 248, 4´ (Takkāriyā ti ~aṃ nāma); Sadd 211, 10 ; 641, 14 ; — 2. ( mfn. ) ( i ) having female (sexual) characteristics ; Vism 184, 4 ; — ( ii ) being feminine in gender ; Sadd 2, 13* (dhātusaddo jinamate ~-ttane mato satthe pulliṅgabhāvasmiṃ); 95, 7 (orodhasaddassa ~-tā); 96, 11 (orodhasaddassa ~-ttaṃ icchatha); — anitthiliṅga, mfn. , not being feminine in gender ; Sadd 112, 2 (āpasaddo anitthiliṅgo ti); — °- saññita , °-saññika, mfn. [ cf S. sañjñikā], called women, meaning women ; Pj II 513, 12 (°-saññikā thiyo) ≠ Nidd-a I 54, 14 ( Ce so; Be, Ee, Se ~ā); Th-a II 118, 1 (tasmiṃ ~e Mārakkhittasmiṃ bandhane); — °- soṇḍī , f. , a woman addicted to drink ; Sn 112 (~iṃ vikiraṇiṃ, Ce, Ee so; Be, Se itthiṃ soṇḍiṃ perhaps better, but less regular metrically; read itthi mc ?); — anitthi , f. , 1. not a woman ; Vin III 144, 10 ; Ja II 126, 25´ ; — 2. ( gr.t.t. ) not the feminine gender ; Abh 791; — duritthi , f. , a poor woman; a low-born woman ; Ja VI 228, 10* (jāto ~iyā; 228, 24´ : ~iyā daḷiddāya kapaṇāya kumbhadāsiyā kucchimhi jāto); — see also appitthika ( sv appa ), itthatta 2 , thī, bahutthika ( sv bahu ).
